name: Multiple @key: Owner Service Only (id key)
query: query UserBase($id: ID!) { user(id: $id) { id username name } }

name: Multiple @key: Cross-Service via Alternate Key (username key to badges)
query: query UserWithBadges($id: ID!) { user(id: $id) { name badges } }

name: Multiple @key: All Fields (both services)
query: query UserFull($id: ID!) { user(id: $id) { id username name badges } }

query: query UserWithBadges($id: ID!) { user(id: $id) { name badges } }

name: Multiple @key: Third User - All Fields
query: query UserFull($id: ID!) { user(id: $id) { id username name badges } }
